pairs: in the second year of king Darius,
factum est verbum Domini ad Zachariam filium Barachiæ filii Addo prophetam,
the word of the Lord came to Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, the prophet,
Iratus est Dominus super patres vestros iracundia.
The Lord has become angry over the resentful anger of your fathers.
And you shall say to them:
Thus says the Lord of hosts:
and I will turn to you,
Do not be like your fathers,
to whom the former prophets cried out,
Thus says the Lord of hosts:
and neither did they pay attention to me,
et prophetæ numquid in sempiternum vivent?
And will the prophets live unceasingly?
Verumtamen verba mea, et legitima mea,
Yet truly my words and my lawfulness,
which I entrusted to my servants the prophets,
numquid non comprehenderunt patres vestros, et conversi sunt,
were indeed comprehended by your fathers, and so they were converted,
Sicut cogitavit Dominus exercituum facere nobis secundum vias nostras, et secundum adinventiones nostras,
Just as the Lord of hosts decided to do to us, according to our ways and according to our inventions,
so has he done to us.
In die vigesima et quarta undecimi mensis Sabath,
On the twenty-fourth day of the eleventh month, which is called Shevat,
in the second year of Darius,
factum est verbum Domini ad Zachariam filium Barachiæ filii Addo prophetam,
the word of the Lord came to Zechariah the son of Berechiah, the son of Iddo, the prophet,
et ecce vir ascendens super equum rufum,
and behold, a man riding on a red horse,
and he stood among the myrtle trees,
And behind him were horses: red,
Et dixit ad me angelus qui loquebatur in me:
And the angel, who was speaking with me, said to me,
Ego ostendam tibi quid sint hæc.
“I will reveal to you what these are.”
Et respondit vir qui stabat inter myrteta,
And the man that stood among the myrtle trees answered and said,
Isti sunt quos misit Dominus ut perambulent terram.
whom the Lord has sent in order to walk through the earth.”
And those who stood among the myrtle trees answered the angel of the Lord,
And the angel of the Lord answered
how long will you not have mercy on Jerusalem
and on the cities of Judah,
with which you have been angry?
This is now the seventieth year.”
Et respondit Dominus angelo qui loquebatur in me verba bona,
And the Lord answered the angel, who had been speaking with me,
Et dixit ad me angelus qui loquebatur in me:
And the angel, who was speaking with me, said to me:
Hæc dicit Dominus exercituum: Zelatus sum Jerusalem et Sion zelo magno,
Thus says the Lord of hosts: I have been zealous for Jerusalem and for Zion with a great zeal.
et ira magna ego irascor super gentes opulentas,
And, with a great anger, I am angry with the wealthy nations.
Though I had been angry a little,
truly they advanced further in evil.
Because of this, thus says the Lord:
I will be turned back, towards Jerusalem, with mercies;
et domus mea ædificabitur in ea,
and my house will be built upon this,
And the building line will be extended over Jerusalem.
Thus says the Lord of hosts: Until then,
my cities will flow with good things, and,
until then, the Lord will comfort Zion, and,
until then, he will single out Jerusalem.
And I lifted up my eyes,
Et dixi ad angelum qui loquebatur in me:
And I said to the angel, who was speaking with me,
Hæc sunt cornua quæ ventilaverunt Judam, et Israël, et Jerusalem.
“These are the horns that have winnowed Judah and Israel and Jerusalem.”
Et ostendit mihi Dominus quatuor fabros.
And the Lord showed me four workmen.
Hæc sunt cornua quæ ventilaverunt Judam per singulos viros,
“These are the horns that have winnowed Judah, through every single man,
et nemo eorum levavit caput suum:
and none of them lifted up his head.
And these have come to frighten them away,
so as to cast down the horns of the Gentiles,
quæ levaverunt cornu super terram Juda ut dispergerent eam.
which have lifted up a horn over the land of Judah, so as to scatter it.”
